date.as_written: śrīmannaipālike varṣe, vāṇaviśikhanandane | māse chaitre site pakṣe, pū(!)rṇamāśyāṃ śubhe dine

purpose: astv idāniṃ jagac chubhaṃ (welfare of the world)
notes: The chronogram 'vāṇa-viśikha-nandana' gives 5-5-9, i.e. NS 955. The verb 'lekhayet' is causative ('caused to be written' / commissioner), though the catalogue identifies Viśvānanda as the scribe.
